name: Jean K. Hyams
tagline: Top rated Employment Litigation attorney in Oakland, California
education: University of California Berkeley School of Law
about: Jean K. Hyams is an attorney providing legal services covering Employment Litigation: Plaintiff, Alternative Dispute Resolution and Employment & Labor: Employee.

Jean Hyams, who practices law in Oakland, California, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2005 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at University of California Berkeley School of Law. She graduated in 1989. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1989.
